item.tib: rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas kyi gnas chog bde chen myur lam
item.coloph: de ltar rigs bdag 'od dpag med mgon gyi gnas chog gi rnam mkhyen bde chen myur lam zhes bya ba 'di ni brda' yig rang shar la gsang sngags gling pas zur du dkrol lo/ yi ge'i 'du byed khro rigs yid rgyal pas/ rang 'dra blo dman la phan snyam gyi bla ma'i zhal rgyan gyis kha bskangs 'gab yig bsdeb ste bris pa'o//
